transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?
I guess… it’s the driving thing. I keep arranging my day so I don’t have to go over those high bridges. And if I can’t avoid one, I just… grip the wheel and get through it.
Do you ever feel sudden, intense fear or panic in other situations, like in crowds, when you’re alone, or in enclosed spaces?
Not really… I haven’t noticed that happening in those kinds of places. It’s mostly just, you know, the driving situation.
Have you ever had episodes where your heart raced, you felt dizzy, or short of breath while driving or in other situations?
Yeah… mostly when I see the bridge coming up. My chest kind of tightens, my hands get sweaty on the wheel, and I just stare straight ahead, like I’m trying to get to the other side.

There is no evidence of panic attacks in other situations or symptoms consistent with other phobias or anxiety disorders. This presentation aligns with specific phobia, situational type.
